text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: realtime-p99 alert fired for route /v1/chat/generate — p99 = 2.7s (SLO 1.2s). Thresholds: p95=800ms, p99=1.2s. Auto-detect: sudden shift at 23:14 UTC
Oncall - Maren: acked, joining. putting phone to do-not-disturb but monitoring.
Miguel (Observability): quick heads-up — dashboards show two clusters diverging: eu-west latency spike and streaming stalls in us-central. p95 up ~3x for eu-west, p99 for us-central streaming tailers hitting 8s.
Oncall - Maren: opening incident channel #incident/latency-5839200000 and paging SRE.
Jess (SRE): on it. first quick checks: checking autoscaler, node counts, pod restarts.
Ara (Runtime Eng): I can look at model KV cache and recent rollouts. Any model variant rollouts in last hour?
Miguel (Observability): @Ara we had a canary earlier for quantized-x1 on eu-west around 22:55 UTC. Canary showed slightly higher p99 but was within thresholds — but rollout to 30% started 23:05.
Oncall - Maren: NOTE: customer impact flag = potential. Top affected routes = /v1/chat/generate, /v1/stream.
Alex (Customer Ops): pinging top customers with degraded requests list. so far 3 accounts reported UI slowness.
Jess (SRE): k8s quick status:
```
kubectl get pods -n redwood-runtime -o wide | grep serve | tail -n 5
serve-6889d   Running  3/3  2d  10.2.1.7   CPU 85%  MEM 62%
serve-6889e   Running  3/3  22m 10.2.1.8   CPU 92%  MEM 68%
serve-6889f   CrashLoopBackOff  0/3 3m 10.2.1.9  recent restarts
```
Jess (SRE): one pod crashlooping in us-central; autoscaler tried to spin up replacements but they're slower to join. CPU high on several pods.
Ara (Runtime Eng): KV cache hit-rate dropped ~40% on eu-west — suspicious. Also some clients hit a new quantized-x1 variant causing longer decode loops in runtime logs. grabbing tail logs.
Miguel (Observability): graph snippets: p99 vs p95 divergence, and stream stall counts (events where last chunk >5s) spiked. sending quick links: https://obs/redwood/dashboards/latency?range=30m
Oncall - Maren: mitigate plan options: 1) pause rollout to quantized-x1 and rollback to stable for eu-west; 2) enable model-fallback routing to stable-medium for streaming only; 3) add temporary burst capacity (if we can) on us-central; 4) scale up k8s nodes. preferences?
Jess (SRE): do (1) and (2) immediately. rollback first to stop spread. I will request burst nodes (cc: infra-autoscaler).
Ara (Runtime Eng): pausing rollout now and forcing variant stable-2026-02 on all eu-west routers. CLI: `redwoodctl rollout pause --variant quantized-x1 --region eu-west`
Ara (Runtime Eng): also: `redwoodctl rollout set --route /v1/chat/generate --variant stable-2026-02 --region eu-west --force` — doing that now.
Miguel (Observability): after rollback p95 improved in eu-west within ~90s, p99 dropping but still elevated. Us-central streaming stalls still elevated.
Jess (SRE): requested burst instances, infra acknowledged and started extra GPUs. scaling ETA ~4m.
Oncall - Maren: customer impact assessment: estimated 6% of total requests degraded in last 15m, major customers A,B,C might see timeouts for streaming. Alex continue customer comms and capture affected request ids.
Alex (Customer Ops): sending canned note to customers and offering rollbacks if they need. Collecting logs & request ids.
Ara (Runtime Eng): logs show long decode loop tied to a new fused-kernel path when sequence length >512 on quantized-x1. suspected regression in kernel selector. Reverting variant eliminated those traces.
Miguel (Observability): streaming backlog queue length across frontends peaked at ~1200, now ~220 after rollback. p99 now at 1.6s in eu-west, us-central streaming p99 ~6s still.
Jess (SRE): for us-central, one node group in the autoscaler has an image pull timeout causing slow join -> addressing with force-recreate: `kubectl rollout restart daemonset infra-puller -n infra`
Kai (Product): any risk to the console / billing pipelines? we should guard against billing spikes from retries.
Oncall - Maren: enable rate-limiter soft caps for affected routes to reduce retry amplification. `featureflip.rate_limit.soft=true --scope=region:us-central,eu-west` - applying now.
Miguel (Observability): add sinthetic p95/p99 monitors to detect streaming-chunk-timeouts separately. Setting alert to create a P0 if stream tailers > 300 within 10m.
Jess (SRE): us-central nodeGroup fixed, new nodes joining and pods scheduling. streaming stalls dropped from 8s p99 to ~2.8s after scaling and rate-limiter.
Oncall - Maren: summary: root cause = variant quantized-x1 rollout causing runtime kernel selection regression and degraded KV cache behavior; secondary contributor = slow node join in us-central amplifying tail latency. Mitigations = rollback quantized-x1, pause rollout, force variant to stable across eu-west, request burst capacity, fix nodegroup join, enable soft rate-limits.
Alex (Customer Ops): sent postmortem-ready incident email to affected customers with mitigation steps and ETA for full resolution.
Miguel (Observability): marking incident as 'Mitigated' in pagerduty. will keep watch for 1h.
Oncall - Maren: moving to post-incident analysis. please add logs, traces, and the KV cache metric snapshots to the incident doc. tagging SRE and Runtime for root-cause follow-up. :white_check_mark:
